senses.gloss: उत्तम- + अङ्ग उत्तम- + अङ्ग, n. the head, Man. 1, 93.
उत्तरा- + अयन उत्तरा- + अयन, Man. 6, 10; and उदगयन, i. e. उदञ्च्-, Man. 1, 67, n. the half of the year in which the sun is to the north of the equator.
उत्तर- + आसङ्ग उत्तर- + आसङ्ग, m. an upper and outer garment, Pañc. 236, 8.

उत उत, part.
 1. And, Chr. 34, 7.
 2. Also, Chr. 3, 8.
 3. उत--उत, As well as, MBh. 3, 10684.
 4. उत--वा--उत--उत, As well as, as also, and, MBh. 5, 916; 917.
 5. उत वा, Or, Brāhmaṇav. 3, 5.
 6. part. of interrogation, What, how. In a disjunctive interrogation: Or, Bhartṛ. 3, 77; also with following वा, Pañc. 68, 14; also with following आहो (उताहो), Nal. 12, 120; also with following आहो स्विद्, Nal. 19, 27-29; also with following स्विद् only, Pañc. 41, 1; seldom with preceding किम् (किम् उत), Mṛcch. 172, 3.
 7. preceded by किम् (किम् उत), Much less, Rām. 4, 35, 8.
 8. preceded by प्रति (प्रत्य् उत), Even, Pañc. iii. d. 27.
उतथ्य उतथ्य, m. The name of a Muni, Man. 3, 16.

उत्तंस उत्तंस, i. e. उद्-तंस् + अ, m.
 1. An ear-ring, Rājat. 5, 138.
 2. A crest.
उत्तंसित उत्तंसित, i. e. उत्तंस + इत, adj. Adorned with, Bhartṛ. 3, 1.

उत्तम उत्तम, i. e. उद् + तम,
 I. adj., f. मा.
 1. Supreme, Chr. 289, 10 = Rigv. i. 50, 10.
 2. Chief, principal, Pañc. 16, 20; best, Man. 4, 229; greatest, Rām. 5, 33, 35; better, Pañc. 241, 24.
 3. Last, MBh. 1, 4674 (cf. ὕστατος).
 II. acc. sing. n. मम्, adv.
 1. Most, Rām. 2, 30, 2.
 2. Very loudly, Chr. 25, 60.
 --Comp.
उत्तमर्ण उत्तमर्ण, i. e. उत्तम + ऋण, m. A creditor, Man. 8, 47.
उत्तमर्णिक उत्तमर्णिक, i. e. उत्तमर्ण + इक, m. A creditor, Man. 8, 48.

उत्तर उत्तर, i. e. उद् + तर,
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Superior, Ragh. 1, 60; more powerful, Chr. 289, 10 = Rigv. i. 50, 10.
 2. Northern, Pañc. 241, 7.
 उत्तरेण (instr. sing.), adv. and prep. (with the gen. abl. and acc.), To the north, Megh. 73.
 3. Left (not right), MBh. 1, 7212.
 4. Posterior, Man. 2, 136; subsequent, Hit. i. d. 143; becoming, fit, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 6.
 5. Future, Rām. 2, 33, 22.
 6. Answering, Rām. 3, 18, 48; Chr. 59, 24.
 II. m. The name of a mountain, Kathās. 25, 23.
 III. f. रा,
 1. The north, Kathās. 18, 57.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 1, 169.
 IV. n.
 1. Superiority, MBh. 1, 4986; power, Rām. 5, 70, 18.
 2. Answer, Rām. 3, 70, 7; defence, Lass. 90, 4.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ὕστερος.
उत्तरा उत्तरा (an old instr. sing. of उत्तर), adv. To the north, e. g. in -मुख, adj. Looking to the north, MBh. 2, 1084.
उत्तार उत्तार, i. e. उद्-तॄ + अ, m. Crossing, passing over, Prab. 83, 10.

उत्तरोत्तर उत्तरोत्तर, i. e. उत्तर-,
 I. adj. 1. always the subsequent, Yājñ. 2, 136. 2. always increasing, Pañc. 84, 25.
 II. -रम्, adv. higher and higher, MBh. 14, 1016; more and more, Hit. 20, 20.
 III. [] n. useless discussion, Hit. 21, 3.
उत्तरण उत्तरण, i. e. उद्-तॄ + अन, n. Crossing, passing over, Pañc. 33, 15.

उत्तारण उत्तारण, i. e. उद्-तॄ-अन, []
 I. adj. Causing to cross, MBh. 14, 194.
 II. n. Deliverance, Rām. 4, 52, 18.
उत्तरतस् उत्तर + तस्, adv. To the north, Rām. 4, 55, 20.
उत्तरीय उत्तरीय, i. e. उत्तर + ईय, and उत्तरीयक उत्तरीय + क, n. An upper and outer garment, Pañc. 236, 9.
उत्तरेद्युस् उत्तरेद्युस्, i. e. उत्तर + इ-दिव् + अस्, adv. The following day, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 5.
उत्तान उत्तान, i. e. उद्-तन् + अ, adj., f. ना, Lying supinely, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 20 (referring to the hand lying with the palm turned upwards).
उत्ताल उत्ताल, i. e. उद्-ताल, adj., f. ला, Formidable, Kathās. 25, 36.
उत्तर- + छद उत्तर- + छद, 1. a cover, MBh. 13, 746. 2. a coverlet, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 6.
उद्- + तरङ्ग उद्- + तरङ्ग, adj. with high waves, Ragh. 7, 33.
उत्तर- + पर्वत उत्तर- + पर्वत, m. the northern ridge of mountains.
उत्तर- + वादिन् उत्तर- + वादिन्, m. the defendant (in an action at law), Yājñ. 2, 17.
उत्तर- + वासस् उत्तर- + वासस्, n. an upper garment, Rām. 5, 18, 5.
उत्तर-वेदि उत्तर-वेदि, f. the northern fire-place, MBh. 3, 7078.
उत्तरायण- + संक्रान्ति उत्तरायण- + संक्रान्ति, i. e. उत्तर-अयन-, f. the sun's entrance into its northern journey, Pañc. 119, 1.
उत्तर- + साधक उत्तर- + साधक, m. one who accomplishes what remains, an assistant, Lass. 3, 20.
